notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; nothing ran with the MuJoCo engine and nothing ran on hardware. The card's mock path is the upstream simulator; the engine is not installed where the gate runs, so the fake backend is the package's stand-in mujoco module (fake.py, a function in backends) that reads model.xml's integration step, joint counts (nq 109, nv 108) and actuator count (78) and advances time and qpos = qvel * timestep. model.xml is a byte-identical copy of the clone's flybody/fruitfly/assets/fruitfly.xml (918 lines, 65,787 bytes). Five gate warnings are expected of this package and are declared, not hidden: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the MuJoCo family's backend is a module and the card names the upstream simulator as the mock path, so the gate treats it as an unrecorded upstream backend; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because the stand-in model publishes no actuator_ctrlrange and there is therefore no limit to probe; and three G8.NO_UNIT for the unitless counts and ctrl elements the simulator family derives (ticks, reset seed, action.ctrl[*]). NOT COVERED: the real MuJoCo engine path (backend sim) was not run; it needs the upstream stack and the 80 mesh .obj assets the XML references (about 154 MB in flybody/fruitfly/assets), which the package does not carry. NOT COVERED: the fly's equations of motion, contacts, adhesion and actuator dynamics, so a ctrl vector changes no state in the fake. NOT COVERED: the per-actuator ctrlrange limits the real engine would derive from the model. NOT COVERED: the clone's dm_control composer environment (observations, rewards, termination); this package serves the raw model, not that environment. NOT COVERED: exact snapshot and restore (the bridge uses the copied time/qpos/qvel/ctrl fallback, not mjSTATE_INTEGRATION) and any wall-clock pacing (realtime_factor 0). Two family defaults did not fit the served contract and are declared in driver.py rather than changed in the SDK: the family's state fields (observation, tick) differ from what MujocoBridge.read serves (time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed), and the reset class fields (seed, scenario, options) are published although the bridge ignores them; the driver declares the bridge's own state keys and describes those inputs, and a maintainer may want to align the family defaults. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted after reviewer edits: the package overrode the private _state_fields hook and set _RESET_INPUTS to get past two SDK defects of the MuJoCo family; the SDK now declares the bridge's state and the reset input (MHS/changes/WAVE-A.md), so both overrides were removed and the reference regenerated. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6, a model and not a human, 2026-11-02; reviewed_by stays null): Accepted the shared MuJoCo checkpoint v2 migration after independent codec review and this actual G1-G9 fake gate rerun. Regenerated the declared native_checkpoint field and conservative derived determinism; state API presence no longer implies seeded or exact continuation. The explicit basic fallback does not claim complete integration state. Earlier automatically inferred determinism is superseded by the current reference. Changed reference.json, REFERENCE.md, check-report.json, RESULT.json. Source pin, package model authorship and driver.lock.json are unchanged. No native runtime of this package or physical hardware was validated; isolated SDK engine tests are separate evidence.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): SDK change MHS/changes/MUJOCO-UNBOUNDED-ACTUATORS.md: the author's stand-in published no actuator_ctrlrange, so the reference bounded no control although the model's main default makes every actuator ctrl-limited (fruitfly.xml:11) and its default classes give all 78 a range; under the SDK change the bridge would have made action.ctrl operator_required. The reviewer made the stand-in read each actuator's ctrlrange and ctrllimited from model.xml's default classes (an approximation of the MJCF compiler, stated in the gaps), so the reference bounds the 78 controls by the model's own ranges (upstream_code) and the gate's G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE warning is gone (G6 and SAFE-014 probe the 156 bounds). Decision: fix, pass. Changed: fake.py; driver.py (docstring, the ctrlrange gap, a fact citing fruitfly.xml:11); facts.md; test_driver.py (a case for the model ranges); reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json regenerated. The gate passes G1-G9 with G6.NOT_RECORDED, G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND and G8.NO_UNIT x3; the digest changed from sha256:79303614599df99dca6c81b92bdff9317f767f5c682fe64de12ed18f1785a07e to sha256:5777e18abf45b5908747279e593eb8e50e99030fea01dcc6391c3cf543920a8a because of this intended correction. Still as before: the fake backend's fidelity is published as engine mujoco F1 although it is a stand-in, and the mesh assets are not carried.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-sonnet-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Different-model review of the reviewer edits made by claude-opus-5-5 with the SDK change MUJOCO-UNBOUNDED-ACTUATORS (the user chose Claude Sonnet as the different model, 2026-11-04): The fake now reads the model's 78 actuator ranges from its default classes, so action.ctrl is published as upstream_code per the model instead of unbounded; docstring, gap, a fact and a test were updated and the gate passes with a new digest (G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE removed). The fidelity is still a stand-in backend. Evidence is contract_checked on the package's fake backend (MuJoCo itself was not run); this is a model review, not a human one.
